Subject: Vector connector sprint retrospective & postmortem

Hi Elena / BlueLake team,

Thanks again for partnering on the connector sprint these last two weeks — really appreciated the quick feedback cycles. We want to run a short retrospective and capture concrete follow-ups so both teams can close open items and stabilize the integration.

Proposed agenda (30 mins):
- What worked: fast validation loop; dataset handoff script
- Pain points: auth refresh flakiness; S3 cold-tier inconsistency
- Actions & ownership: tech fixes, test coverage, Docs updates

Can you do Tuesday or Wednesday next week (your timezone)? If not, share a 30-min slot and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a very small note template to capture findings.

Attachments: bluelake-retro-notes.pdf (1 page, agenda template)

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Soojin — I can lead the internal prep and bring a short tech summary. Preliminary notes:
- Root cause of auth refresh: race condition in token cache (repro on long-lived streams)
- S3 cold-tier: eventual-consistency reads hit older manifests; we saw ~2x reindex attempts
- Pinecone fallback: we exercised the fallback path successfully twice (logs attached)

I’ll drop the timeline CSV into Drive and attach a short log extract here.

Attachments: sprint-timeline.csv (export), pinecone-fallback.log.txt (truncated)

—Ben
Ben Carter

Thanks Soojin — Tuesday works for us (May 7, 10:00am PT). High level feedback ahead of the call so we can be efficient:

- The connector mostly met our ingest SLA but we saw 1.5–2x latency spikes during heavy cold reads.
- We have two priority asks: deterministic retry behavior for failed chunk uploads, and clearer visibility into which objects were served from S3 cold vs warm cache.
- The auth token issue impacted one of our CI pipelines (we recreated it with a long-lived stream).

We’ll bring a short ops report and a sample manifest that shows the cold-tier behavior. I’ll also invite our Cloud Ops lead, Javier, if that’s ok.

Elena Gomez
Head of Integrations, BlueLake Analytics
elena@bluelake.ai

Thanks all — good meeting earlier. Summarizing action items and owners (short timeline):

1) Token cache race fix — owner: Karthik (PR w/in 3 business days, rollout Canary next week). Jira: INT-4821.
2) Deterministic retry for chunk uploads — owner: Ben (design doc + tests w/in 5 business days).
3) Cold vs warm visibility: add trace flag + example query in docs — owner: Vanessa (docs update + sample query by EOD Fri).
4) Reindex mitigation: BlueLake to provide failing manifest; Redwood to add guard to indexer to ignore stale manifests (prototype in 4 business days).

Drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-bluelake-retro
